def rows_target(n):
    pts=[]
    import ipaddress, random
    r=random.Random(n)
    routes={}
    rows=[["::/0",0]]
    routes[(0,0)]=0
    hop=1
    while len(rows)<n:
        v=r.getrandbits(120)<<8
        if (v,128) in routes: continue
        routes[(v,128)]=hop
        rows.append([str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v))+"/128",hop]); hop+=1
    return rows
